source.quote: SMSL's own page for the DO200 MKII, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « 2x advanced ES9068AS D/A chips, fully optimized to THD+N as low as -122dB, far exceeding the official specifications; »; « XMOS XU-316, a true 32bit USB solution, supporting DoP256 and native DSD512, PCM supports up to 768kHz; »; « All input ports support DSD(Except BT), coaxial, optical and AES support DoP64; »

facts.chip: Two ESS ES9068AS (« 2x advanced ES9068AS D/A chips »), XMOS XU-316 on USB.

_the_ceiling_is_the_XMOS_bullet: The rate and DSD ceilings come from the bullet naming the XMOS USB receiver, so they are written on usb only. No other input is given a PCM rate: the page states none.
_optical_has_DoP64_and_no_rate: Optical and coaxial get DoP64 from the maker's own clause and no PCM ceiling, because none is stated: copying 768 kHz onto optical is the error vocabulary/why-the-optical-default-stays-low.json exists to prevent.
_aliases_MKII: SMSL writes « DO200 MKⅡ » with a Roman-numeral character in its heading; the model is written here in ASCII.
